plugins.name: product-brain
plugins.description: The brainify skill + pb CLI: create and maintain a Product Brain hub. Installing puts pb on PATH and makes 'set up product brain' available — no manual copy, no PATH editing. Also ships the brand-system skill (one product-level DESIGN.md, compiled to brand/) and the delivery-roadmap, release-notes, update-product-hub and hub-portal artifact skills, all styled only from that brand.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Commit-message and merge-request rules in every session, a commit-message hook, a ticket-scope gate before MR/PR creation, and verify-ticket-scope / review-mr skills.

plugins.name: epic-approval
plugins.description: Approval gate before an epic launches: per hub repo (backend, frontend, mobile), finds or creates the release branch (next version from the latest release and the commit messages on develop), reviews what it would merge into main against five criteria (scope, error & edge cases, security basics, backward compatibility, deployment/config risk) and writes one report per repo plus a summary into the hub.

plugins.name: live-update
plugins.description: Files one Jira ticket for a release once its epic-approval reports and release notes exist: links the merge/pull request, uploads the local-only artifacts as attachments, and never files a duplicate. The project and component come from brain.config.json (or are asked for).

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Blocks Claude writes that violate shared engineering standards (secrets, debug output, unsafe PHP/TS/React patterns and more), for whichever stacks each repo actually contains. Runs as a hook — nothing is written to your repos.

plugins.name: stack-laravel
plugins.description: Laravel conventions: architecture, Eloquent, migrations, validation, queues and Playwright end-to-end tests.

plugins.name: stack-inertia
plugins.description: Inertia monolith conventions: the Laravel/React seam, typed props, Wayfinder routing, form handling and Playwright end-to-end tests.

plugins.name: stack-angular
plugins.description: Angular conventions: signals, standalone components, change detection, RxJS lifetime, typed forms and Playwright end-to-end tests.

plugins.name: stack-symfony
plugins.description: Symfony conventions: dependency injection, controllers, Doctrine, the messenger component and Playwright end-to-end tests.

plugins.name: stack-flutter
plugins.description: Flutter conventions: widget composition, state management, async safety and integration_test end-to-end tests.
